subtitles.content: Watch! This man, rifle in hand, runs toward a Tesla Power Up—
now, he’s firing wildly at the driver inside!
Mike is—
Meanwhile, an armed citizen showed up, gun in hand,
and fired at the shooter.
Hello all! I’m eleven,
and welcome to this episode
of The Thin Blue Line on bilibili!
Today’s case took place in Twin Falls, Idaho.
On the afternoon of the first of august , twenty twenty six,
a mass shooting broke out outside a burger joint
in northern Twin Falls.
leading to four deaths— including the shooter— and seven shot.
It was later confirmed that the shooter in this case
was twenty four year old Chad Williams.
Reportedly, this suspect had no criminal record
nor any known history of mental illness
prior to the incident.
From twenty twenty two to twenty twenty three,
suspect Chad Williams
briefly attended the College of Southern Idaho.
It’s a public, comprehensive community college
located in Twin Falls, Idaho—
where this case took place.
Reportedly, Chad Williams didn’t graduate.
the first of august , twenty twenty six, two PM.
Suspect Chad Williams,
armed with an A R fifteen rifle and a handgun,
drove his Honda Civic to the burger joint’s drive thru lane.
Note: the Twin Falls Police Department said
the case video released was edited to protect privacy
and avoid showing graphic footage.
muted, blurred, and had freeze frames removed.
Gotta say, for an event this thrilling,
if I were there, I’d want to film it all with my new phone!
For instance, I sold my Xiaomi fifteen S Pro
via Zhuanzhuan’s at home pickup
for over three thousand four hundred yuan—
only after using it
did I realize just how convenient they are:
one tap to order,
and a recycler comes to your door for a free appraisal!
Shopping hubs, office buildings, residential areas—
they can come right over! Beats hunting down recycling shops
to ask prices, or posting online
only to struggle for ages and still not sell anything.
Now with Zhuanzhuan, you don’t even have to leave your door—
your old stuff swaps easily for cash!
Plus, Zhuanzhuan now takes a wide array of items—
like digital goods such as headphones,
tablets, and laptops.
They even offer at home pickup for luxury goods
like LV bags and watches—
perfect for someone like me
who wants to sell old stuff but hates the hassle!
If you ask me, to sell old stuff,
don’t bother asking around—Zhuanzhuan’s at home pickup
is the way to go!
This is surveillance footage from outside the burger joint,
starting at two twenty nine PM on the first of august ,
twenty twenty six.
Note the red circle: suspect
Chad Williams rolls down his window
and fires straight at the staffer at the payment window.
This was the first victim in this case,
one Ashley Garibay, who died from her severe wounds
after being rushed to hospital for care.
Then, suspect Chad Williams drove his car to the front door,
got out with a handgun,
and fired at the driver inside that car.
This is the second victim in this case,
named Christopher Claunch,
who died at the scene from his severe wounds.
At that same time,
Austin James—a former Idaho State Trooper
and ex Twin Falls Police Department cop—
queued up behind to grab his meal—
heard gunshots ring out up front.
Then, that ex cop leaped from his car
and dashed toward the shooting scene,
only to run into the gunman and become the third person shot.
Now, former officer Austin James
drew his pistol to engage the shooter,
but due to severe wounds and heavy blood loss,
his own wife pulled him back into the car for treatment.
It bears noting that
as former officer Austin James rushed to the scene,
he held off on drawing his pistol
lest police mistake him for the shooter.
After being shot by the suspect,
he received medical aid from his nurse wife
and was rushed to the hospital.
Then, the suspect, Chad Williams,
headed back to the payment window,
where he saw staff tending to the first victim.
He fired toward the window a second time,
but his pistol malfunctioned,
so he went back to his car and grabbed his A R fifteen rifle.
Meanwhile, inside the burger joint,
an off duty state trooper, Steve McClain, stepped up;
he drew his personal handgun
and evacuated the patrons and staff within.
Now, suspect Chad Williams, rifle in hand,
fires upon folks at the pickup lane.
Then, he returned to the payment window for a third time—
note this off duty state trooper, Steve McClain,
scouting for the shooter’s location.
Right then, he engaged in a gunfight
with the shooter outside, Chad Williams.
The suspect, Williams, who’d been calm
as could be, heard those gunshots
and pissed his pants in fear!
Then, he returned to the payment window for a fourth time
and fired bullets inside.
The fourth victim— that off duty state trooper, Steve McClain—
then gave that victim medical aid,
saving a life.
Now, suspect Chad Williams popped his trunk,
grabbed a backpack and a gun,
and headed to the front pickup window.
Seeing no one inside, he headed outside to find targets.
Watch closely: this woman who fled the restaurant
is sprinting along the outer wall—
and then she comes face to face with the shooter.
Now, this woman ducks behind the shooter’s car
and snags his discarded, faulty pistol.
but suspect Chad Williams paid it no mind,
striding straight toward nearby Blue Lakes Boulevard.
and fired at several cars parked at the intersection,
hitting three victims.
Just then, the woman fled the scene.
Zooming in, we see suspect Chad Williams
running toward the Tesla Power Up lot on the left.
Now, a armed citizen appears at right, firing at the gunman.
Inquiry shows this good Samaritan
is thirty five year old Jordan Salinas;
here’s video of him firing at the gunman,
captured by bystanders.
Now, suspect Chad Williams
dashed into the Power Up station’s lot,
where he fired upon the first Tesla,
hitting victims number eight and nine inside.
then fired at the second Tesla, killing the tenth victim,
Dale Schultz.
Bought twenty six.
Next, suspect Chad Williams, gun in hand,
crossed the parking lot
and headed to the Twin Falls Visitor Center.
Five minutes post shooting,
the first patrol cop reached the scene.
You can see this off duty state trooper, Steve McClain,
dash out and point out
the shooter’s escape route to the cops.
This is the surveillance footage
from the visitor center’s entrance;
since things happened so suddenly,
three visitors and staff members inside hid at the spot
circled in blue.
Luckily, suspect Chad Williams didn’t spot them.
Then, the suspect headed out the back door—
but as luck would have it,
dozens of staff from the visitor center,
thinking the shooter was at the front parking lot,
rushed over to the back walkway.
Watch! Many staff members are running over from afar.
This brave staffer tangled with the gunman,
buying those running down the path
crucial time to flee for their lives.
Just then, suspect Chad Williams realized he’d been played
and fired straight at the staffer by the front door.
Luckily, the bullets missed
anyone; now, suspect Chad Williams flees with his gun,
having heard the sirens wail.
Note the red circle far off—that’s the shooter, Chad Williams.
Officers fanned out, rifles in hand, searching the area.
The time is now two thirty five PM—
six minutes since this mass shooting began.
The Twin Falls Police Department
and Twin Falls County Sheriff's Office
dispatched over fifty officers to the scene.
This is footage from the body camera
of the first officers on scene;
they headed to where the gunfire had just rung out.
About a minute later,
officers on site spotted the suspect, Chad Williams,
hiding down the slope.
but as officers barked out commands,
the suspect—who’d shot three dead and wounded
seven—put the gun to himself and pulled the trigger,
his body then tumbling down into the canyon below.
And so, this nine minute mass shooting came to a close;
let’s jump straight to the aftermath.
Afterwards, we learned the twenty four year old suspect,
Chad Williams, was pronounced dead at the scene.
A Twin Falls County Coroner's Office spokesperson said
the suspect,
Chad Williams’s, cause of death
was deemed a fatal gunshot to the head,
with the manner of death ruled suicide.
As we said earlier,
he attended the College of Southern Idaho;
upon enrolling, suspect Chad Williams successfully ran for
and took on the role of student senator.
His former college classmate and roommate, Elijah Mosley,
revealed…
To keep the scholarship tied to his student council post,
members had to meet basic requirements like staffing shifts,
attending meetings, and planning events—
but Williams was often absent.
Ultimately, for procedural reasons,
he was impeached mid term
and stripped of his student council post.
In december twenty twenty three,
after just over a year enrolled, he left campus for good,
sans any degree or diploma.
Then, on the first of august , twenty twenty six,
suspect Chad Williams re emerged in the public eye—
by committing this mass shooting.
Confirmed: victims in this case include
twenty three year old Ashley Garibay,
Hailing from Stockton, California,
she was a manager at that burger joint
and was tragically shot dead inside.
and sixty six year old Dale Schultz, from Salt Lake City, Utah.
He was driving back with his wife
after a family get together
and was shot dead by the suspect
in an indiscriminate shooting
while charging their car at a Tesla Power Up station.
and fifty nine year old Christopher Claunch,
from Hagerman, Idaho,
who was tragically shot and killed in his car
while queuing at the burger joint to grab his meal.
Seven other civilians were shot,
among them the wife of Tesla Power Up victim Dale Schultz.
Plus, in this mass shooting,
Armed citizen Jordan Salinas, thirty five,
and an off duty Idaho State Trooper, Steve McClain,
tried to shoot and stop the gunman.
The former, Jordan Salinas, is a local medical caregiver.
At the time,
he was heading out for a date with his girlfriend;
upon hearing the volley of shots, Salinas acted decisively.
He fired at the suspect using an FN Five seveN
fitted with a suppressor.
This is a training video
Jordan Salinas posted on his own social media pages.
Also, firing back was off duty state trooper Steve McClain,
who boasts twelve years of law enforcement experience.
Post incident, the state trooper released a statement saying, “
My heart goes out to the victims,
their families, the injured,
and all those impacted by this tragedy.”
Like many folks there that day,
I just did what I felt I had to do—
lots of folks stepped up to aid strangers,
heedless of their own peril.
I am so grateful for their courage and kindness—
and especially thankful for the training
I received in my career
that enabled me to handle this horrific event.
I take pride in having fought alongside
the Idaho State Police,
the Twin Falls Police Department,
and other law enforcement personnel.
May this community lean on one another
to heal from this grief and grow stronger and more united.
Lastly, we must mention that former cop
who charged the gunman—
Austin James—
who once served with both the Idaho State Police
and the Twin Falls Police Department.
Upon hearing a volley of gunfire,
Austin told his wife and friend in the car to stay put,
then hopped out and charged toward the source of the shots.
He was then shot in the shoulder by the suspect.
Post incident, the former officer’s father said
his son didn’t draw his pistol
since he feared arriving cops
might mistake him for the shooter.
That father, too, is a cop.
Post incident, the family of that injured ex cop, Austin James,
launched a fundraising drive.
So far, two hundred thousand dollars has been raised,
which will go toward his medical costs.
As of this posting, I’ve found no further news on this case,
and the suspect Chad Williams’s motive remains unclear.
Lastly, this case left four dead—
including the suspect—and seven injured.
Thanks for watching!
If you liked my video,
please coin, like,
and follow The Thin Blue Line Channel on bilibili;
feel free to leave comments below—
thank you so much!
Oh! And a huge shout out to Zhuanzhuan
for sponsoring this video—
since there’s a sale on now, go snag some new gadgets!
